problem_type: Curated mode wire aliases overwrite selected catalog identity on another transport
symptom: Canvas selection gpt-image-2 submits gpt-image-2-text-to-image to native images/generations and receives HTTP 400.
direct_cause: referenceInputParams overlays archetypeInput.model after taskTemplateParams chooses catalog identity; native relay templates consume that projected mode alias.
class_root: Transport projection lacks an ownership boundary between catalog model identity, intentional variants and a curated mode alias belonging to another protocol.
affected_population: Other curated image families exposed by native image relays
internal_only_reason: The invariant is an internal ownership violation, reproduced from production canvas assembly and request construction. CLIProxy source was checked read-only to confirm rejected mode aliases; no provider model-name suffix is guessed or stripped.
invariants: Native image transport must retain selected catalog identity when the only override is a recognized curated mode alias.
Literal custom mappings, other protocols, declared variants and reference bytes remain unchanged.
Normalization never mutates catalog rows or persisted request intent.

door_reduction.why_not: JSON, multipart, process and audio executors remain distinct transport lifecycles, but every caller supplies its operation to the same templateContext owner. Process/audio operations do not meet the native-image shape guard and remain unchanged.

generality_proof: Detection derives exact alias membership from curated identity without node/custom metadata, spans image families and saved requests, and gates by native image operation shape rather than vendor name. JSON and actual multipart dispatch converge before rendering.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Finalize all template parameters, then normalize cross-protocol curated mode identity using the selected operation and catalog row.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Production renderer assembly is the test fixture producer and its extras reach templateContext unchanged.
Final FormData model and actual reference bytes are captured in the regression test.
JSON delegates to buildProfileHttpRequest; process passes the same complete operation to templateContext and fails the native-image shape guard.
Audio operations retain their distinct endpoint/fields and therefore do not satisfy the image-only normalization guard.

recurrence.reason: Global curated identity matching can project another protocol's mode IDs for any relay and matching image family.
same_class_scan: Inspected taskTemplateParams, referenceInputParams, canvas builder and actual multipart renderer independently

prevention.invariant: Transport-aware final model projection follows catalog identity instead of an unrelated curated mode ID.
prevention.failure_mode: Unsupported actual catalog identities remain visible provider errors; no speculative aliases, automatic retry or provider fallback is introduced.
prevention.strategy: Exact curated-mode membership plus structural native endpoint/template detection; preserve all other existing mappings and variants.

legacy_paths.rationale: Replace unconditional cross-protocol model projection at the shared renderer; existing saved projections are normalized in-memory, not rewritten on disk.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No dependency chooses these application-owned aliases; installed runtime and provider transport are retained unchanged.

migration: No project migration. Existing catalog key/alias and stored canvas intent are preserved; stale generated aliases are recognized at render time, even when a new custom capability contract now exists.
residual_risks: Provider-native exact pixel sizing remains provider behavior and is not repaired by model identity normalization.
Real generation and zh/en runtime acceptance remain required after implementation.
Generic DALL-E quality controls must not be silently reinterpreted as GPT Image pricing tiers.
